title: Protonated High Energy Density Materials: N4 Tetrahedron and N8 Octahedron (Leininger, Van Huis, Schaefer, J. Phys. Chem. A 1997, 101, 4460)

species.source_note: Table 6, p.4463: rNN column, TZ2Pf CCSD(T) row = 1.463 A. Single edge length (all 6 edges equivalent by Td symmetry).
species.notes: Likely duplicate topology of existing N4_Td in molecules.py -- but this CCSD(T)/TZ2Pf value (1.463 A) is a high-quality independent literature value, useful as a cross-check/alternative reference even if topologically redundant. Paper confirms Td N4 is a genuine minimum (harmonic frequencies all real, Table 7).

species.method: CCSD/DZP (highest correlated level given for pure N8 in Table 2; no CCSD(T) row for N8 itself)
species.source_note: Table 2, p.4462: rNN column for N8 (not vertex-protonated), DZP CCSD row = 1.517 A. Single edge length (all 12 edges equivalent by Oh symmetry, cube).
species.notes: Likely duplicate topology of existing N8_Oh_cube/N8_Oh_cubane_GS in molecules.py -- cross-check bond length. Paper confirms Oh N8 is a genuine minimum (Table 3, all frequencies real/positive).

notes_batch: This paper's real focus (protonated N4H+/N8H+ forms) is out of scope (contains H) and correctly skipped -- only the parent pure-N Td N4 and Oh N8 species extracted.
